name: Draconic Tail (Combat, Mythic)
body:
Your tail becomes a deadly energy weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic Tail.

Benefit(s): Your tail attack deals damage as if you were one size larger. If your claw attacks deal energy damage, your tail deals 1d6 additional points of energy damage too.
